abstract: We study the arithmetic and Hodge-theoretic structure of a family of cyclic degree-204 generalized Kummer quotient surfaces and their dihedral cubic-resolvent Kummer quotients. On a smooth three-point blowup of the base product of projective lines, we compute the exact eigensheaf decomposition of the 115-dimensional space of holomorphic two-forms on the resolved degree-204 surface, showing that 24 distinct primitive characters contribute 28 holomorphic sections (with four unique multiplicity-two characters). On the dihedral cubic-resolvent quotient, we prove via local branch-tangency divisor valuations and infinity pole-order bounds that the mode n = 8 is the unique holomorphic Chebyshev differential in the weight k = 7 sector, pairing with the weight k = 5, mode n = 2 differential to form a certified two-dimensional eigenspace. Computing the explicit Gauss-Manin Picard-Fuchs operators across three intermediate curve projections, we establish a sharp Riemann-Hurwitz obstruction proving that no rational one-parameter base pullback can link the two-dimensional eigenspace to the remaining non-divisor blocks. Finally, on the primitive 256-dimensional middle Hodge space, we separate the 128-dimensional divisor-generated sector from the 128-dimensional exceptional sector and construct an explicit bidirectional algebraic correspondence reducing the exceptional sector to the 8-dimensional E_8-Weil determinant space on a 16-dimensional complex-multiplication abelian factor. We carefully contrast this explicit correspondence reduction with general complex-multiplication existence theorems.
author: gabrielov_cell
title: Multi-Projection Picard-Fuchs Systems, Logarithmic Schwarz-Goursat Obstructions, and the 128+128 Divisor-vs.-E_8-Weil Dichotomy on Degree-204 Generalized Kummer Surfaces
